about: Past seasons as the season simulator saw them at the time (out of sample: every number uses only matches played before it). Per season and club: final position, then per set of ratings one list per outcome with the chance after 0, 1, ..., 33 matchdays, in thousandths. Outcomes: title (1st), top4, drop (17th-18th), playoff (16th). The settings were chosen on 2014/15 to 2018/19, so those seasons are in-sample for them.
